Inspect a GeoPackage

Source: R/domain.R
inspect_geopackage.Rd

Lists the layers of a GeoPackage and, for the requested layers, reports CRS, extent, fields, number of features and geometric validity. Read only.

Usage

inspect_geopackage(path, layers = NULL, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Path to the .gpkg.

layers

Layer names to describe in detail.

verbose

Print the report.

Value

Invisible list with the information.
